RECORD OF INVESTIGATION.
Foreigner handed over by the North Szechuen Road
Police Station, S.P.S. Bureau.

At 5.15 p.m. on the 1-4-36 a telephone message was
received from the Officer i/c of the North Szechuen Road
Police Station, S.P.S. Bureau, stating they had a foreigner
in custody, and wished to hand him over to this station.

The Officer i/c of this District and the undersigned
attended the said station.

It was learned Albert Maitland, aged 30 years,
unemployed, British subject (not registered in the H.B.M.
Consulate, as stated by Maitland) was arrested at 3.30 p.m.
on the 1-4-36 in the rear room of No. 49 Jukong Road, O.O.
L., on suspicion of dealing in heroin by officers attached
to the North Szechuen Road Police Station and members of
the Japanese Consulate Police. At the same time one
Korean and two Chinese males were arrested in the front
room of the house where heroin was seized.

No narcotics were found in the room where Maitland
was arrested and nothing of an incriminating nature was
found on his person. The Officer i/c of the North Sze-
chuen Road Police Station stated Maitland had not been
implicated by the Korean or Chinese.

He was handed over to this station and further
questioned when it was elicited that on the night of the
31-3-36 he went to the house mentioned to meet a Korean
who he learned
had been arrested by the Japanese Consulate Police two

调查记录。
由四川北路捕房（特别股）移交的外国人。

1936年4月1日下午5时15分，接到四川北路捕房（特别股）主管警官的电话留言，称该捕房羁押了一名外国人，希望将其移交给本捕房。

本区主管警官及签署人前往上述捕房。

获悉阿尔伯特·梅特兰（Albert Maitland），30岁，无业，英国臣民（据梅特兰称，未在英国驻华领事馆注册），于1936年4月1日下午3时30分，在越界筑路区域菊康路49号的后屋内，因涉嫌贩卖海洛因，被隶属于四川北路捕房的警员及日本领事馆警察逮捕。同时，在该房屋的前屋内查获海洛因，并逮捕了一名朝鲜男子和两名中国男子。

在梅特兰被捕的房间内未发现任何毒品，在其身上也未发现任何具有定罪性质的物品。四川北路捕房主管警官表示，梅特兰未被那名朝鲜人或中国人供出。

他被移交给本捕房并接受进一步讯问，由此得知，在1936年3月31日晚，他前往上述房屋去见一名朝鲜人，他得知该朝鲜人已于两天前被日本领事馆警察逮捕，他一直留在后屋，直到他被

（批：1936年4月3日收悉 梅特兰！！）
（批：警务副总监助理（罪案））
（印：罪案组副总监）
（批：归档 3/2）
